newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki ends off but still defies bears.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki ends off but still defies bears.

text.p: Finnish shares fell in thinner trade than of late on Friday but pared losses in late dealings although the outlook was turning more uncertain, brokers said.

The market started strong, with the HEX up more than one percent at a new all time high of 2,740.33, but soon fell back to hit a low of 2,696.90 before scratching back some ground as the dollar picked up to end at 2,740.33, down 0.15 percent.
That still meant a 3.1 percent gain over last Friday.
Trade was modest compared to recent massive volumes with investors sidelined, awaiting Wall Street's reaction to Federal Reserve comments which on Thursday revived interest jitters.
Bourse engine Nokia closed flat at 307.00 markka, accounting for almost 25 percent of trade, and decliners beat advancing issues by 53 to 36 with 31 unchanged.
Brokers said there were early attempts to make the market look stronger than it was, bringing the early unsustained high.
"I think we are in for a bit less calm over the next few weeks -- not any really big drop but more seesawing," said one.
Raisio rose again, adding 16.00 markka or 4.41 percent to 379.00 but brokers could give no specific explanation.
Merita also extended its bull-run, up 0.40 markka at 16.50 in lively trade.
Valmet rose 2.00 markka to close lively trade at 82.00 after a big order accounced Thursday and a positive article in weekly Talouselama, brokers said.
